question: At the live F1 rev13 pins, do worker-062's two schema-side R03 repair candidates preserve the frozen R03 binder guard's ability to reject a scope-erroneous formal rendering (negation binds only q, t0 conjoined outside) and a free-t0 rendering? The formulation lead measured that the tool-side variable-wise patch cand_E3 3f69bc1eb27a accepts the scope-error rendering; the schema-side candidates have not been scope-probed.
selection_basis: Self-selected from the live G-FORM blocker lead-form-20260912T011509-122/123 (R03 repair must not silently weaken the guard; stage-2 instrument governance). No assignment card exists in comms/inbox/worker-029.jsonl.

tails.G_grouped_correct: not exists (q,t0) in I+ x [0,T) with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.
tails.V_variable_wise_correct: not exists q in I+ and t0 in [0,T) with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.
tails.S_scope_error_negation_binds_q_only: not exists q in I+ with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M, and t0 in [0,T).
tails.U_free_t0_no_restriction: not exists q in I+ with gamma([t0,T)) subset J^-(q) intersect M.

method.mutation: Load each base YAML, replace everything after the unique anchor in quantifiers.formal with the tail, dump with yaml.safe_dump(sort_keys=False). All other bytes (including the base's ordered rows and D5) are inherited unchanged.
method.tool_invocation: python3 artifacts/worker-06/spec_conformance_audit.py <variant>  (exactly the frozen pipeline invocation; verdict read from stdout JSON per the auditor contract; exit code recorded)

declared_expectations.CAND_B__S: accept (scope guard lost; primary decision row)
declared_expectations.CAND_B__U: accept (free t0 invisible; secondary decision row)

method.reading_rule: A base is scope-safe at this probe iff its binder set makes R03 reject BOTH S and U while accepting its own correct rendering. CAND-A inherits the tuple binder (q,t0); CAND-B replaces it with scalar q.
method.decision_rule: If CAND-B accepts S and/or U while CAND-A rejects both, report CAND-B as not scope-safe and recommend CAND-A (or CAND-B only with an ordered-binding repair plus a scope-aware rule) and raise a landing blocker. If both reject S and U, report both scope-safe on this probe. If CAND-A also accepts S or U, report both unsafe and escalate the repair decision.

controls.K1_fail_closed: CAND-B with ordered[5].kind set to an invalid token must be rejected by R03 (proves the tool is live and fail-closed at the same bytes)
controls.K2_determinism: every variant run twice; verdict/failed_rules must be identical
controls.K3_pin_stability: all nine declared pins re-measured after the run; any drift voids the run
controls.K4_one_line_diff: recursive leaf-diff canonical vs each candidate must show exactly one changed leaf, at the declared path (CAND-A quantifiers.formal; CAND-B quantifiers.ordered[5].binder)
controls.K5_lead_matrix_reproduction: the E3 tool 3f69bc1eb27a on the lead's three published variants must reproduce the lead's matrix (frozen reject, grouped accept, scope-error accept)
controls.K6_stdout_vs_json: one case cross-checked with --json: verdict must agree with the stdout parse

scope_limits: Stage-B R03 only; the full two-stage acceptance pipeline, corpus rebind and stage-A gate are out of scope.
No canonical write; variants are written only under artifacts/worker-029/f1_r03_scope_safety/.
Not a full-schema G-FORM verdict; does not consume a reviewer slot and does not count toward gate acceptance.

falsifier: Re-run run_f1_r03_scope_safety.py at the same declared pins: falsified if CAND-B+S or CAND-B+U is rejected by R03, if CAND-A+S or CAND-A+U is accepted, if either candidate's own bytes fail, if any declared pin moves T0->T1, or if the recursive one-line diff does not match the declared leaf.
stop_rule: 1 agent-hour; stop and report a blocker rather than patching if a pinned file moves, if the frozen tool cannot be invoked on a variant, or if a candidate's own bytes do not reproduce the declared accept.
